title: lolium perenne subsp. multiflorum
intro: Lolium perenne subsp. multiflorum, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a subspecies of Lolium perenne, a perennial grass native to Europe, Asia, and Africa. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Italian ryegrass include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. The bioactive constituents of Lolium perenne subsp. multiflorum also exhibit antimicrobial and cytotoxic activities, making it a potential source of new medicinal compounds.
